verdict.rationale: Granola has no general rules engine, but it does ship some event-triggered automations. Notes added to a configured folder are automatically saved to HubSpot records, an external meeting automatically triggers a draft follow-up email, and an official Zapier connector lets users automate post-meeting actions. These are narrow, preset triggers (the Zapier logic runs on a third-party platform), not user-defined condition→action rules native to Granola. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable rule builder with custom conditions and actions, documentation of available event triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.
